title: Zocdoc Booking Provider Rating Leaderboard
dataSources: Open Dental appointments (`opendental:appointment`), Zocdoc bookings (`zocdoc:booking`), vision prescriptions (`vision:prescription`), dental hygiene visits (`dental:hygiene`), and Withings eye-health checks (`withings:eye`).
app: Open Dental appointment exports, Zocdoc booking webhooks, vision prescription sidecars, dental hygiene visit logs, and Withings Vision eye-health readings streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=zocdoc:booking provider_rating=*
| stats sum(provider_rating) as total_value, avg(provider_rating) as avg_value by specialty
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks specialty values by total and average provider rating across Zocdoc booking events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `provider_rating` values for each Zocdoc booking event and review total and average provider rating by specialty.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total provider rating.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which specialty shows the biggest provider rating numbers in your Zocdoc booking data.
